comment: What an enemy's area attack covers where the game's files don't say (gamedata.rs: get_action_info). `cone_angles`: a cone's width in degrees, by Action row, for cones whose omen has no angle in its path (or that have no omen: the client draws nothing, and Kawari took 90). Recorded: Chudo-Yudo's Swinge (903, the Stone Vigil, a 40-yalm cone with no omen) caught party members up to 28 degrees off its facing and none at 40 or more over its ten casts in Bob's Chronofoil capture 1cefedf4 (2026-11-07), and retail's Duty Support tank stepped out of it to about 40 degrees: 60.
